svg.aria-label: Keeping watch on AI. A burst chart of the SafeAI.watch record: 51 dated, sourced entries from Mar 2023 to Sep 2026, one dot each: 15 warnings, 15 incidents, 11 governance, 10 research. Distance from the centre is the entry's date, so the record thickens toward 2026.
